record_schema.selection_order: integer produced before any outage lookup
record_schema.stratum_key: canonical serialization of declared matching variables
record_schema.source_event_ids: array; empty only for calendar controls
record_schema.matched_event_id: accepted hazard event id or null

invariants: No outage value, outage threshold, or customer denominator participates in selection_order or candidate_status.
A missing EAGLE-I label is UncoveredLabel, never zero.
The manifest cannot call a row accepted before both weather and outage coverage decisions are evidenced.
Calendar controls and diagnostic hazard near misses remain separate cohorts.
